name: Sunghyeon Jo(ainta)
description: Sunghyeon Jo is a co-founder of QED Audit, which focuses on Continuous Web3 Security. His work focuses on zero-knowledge proof systems, cryptanalysis, and proximity gaps. His recent research includes ZEE200, accepted at ACM CCS 2026. He also has a strong competitive programming background, including IOI and ICPC World Finals Gold medals and Legendary Grandmaster in Codeforces.
